title: Qualify native GitHub attestation transport
objective: Add a native GitHub Artifact Attestation transport for the already-defined canonical provenance envelope using an exact pinned actions/attest release and least-privilege permissions, then qualify it with an engineering-only transport probe that cannot be interpreted as business or T4 certification.
non_goals: redefine canonical provenance identity or domain integrity digests
push an OCI artifact or create an artifact storage record

required_invariants: transport consumes the WU01 provenance envelope and never recomputes or substitutes its canonical identity
actions/attest is pinned to exact audited commit 1e69f48acb82d1966a394da916b4c1698aa569d6 for immutable release v4.2.2
only certification-provenance.yml may receive id-token write and attestations write approvals
workflow retains contents read and does not receive packages security-events actions checks or artifact-metadata write
probe subject digest equals the canonical provenance envelope SHA-256 identity
probe uses assurance status NOT_REQUIRED and candidate id ENG-06.4-ATTESTATION-PROBE on the exact workflow head
probe transport cannot emit a promotion T4 or business-certification verdict
native attestation transport is zero-cost for this public repository and requires no LLM
acceptance_criteria: actions/attest v4.2.2 exact commit is registered with MIT-license evidence
supply-chain changed gate accepts only the registered exact SHA
permission gate accepts exactly id-token write and attestations write for certification-provenance.yml
transport policy rejects any additional write scope or floating action ref
transport validator emits a self-validating engineering-only provenance envelope and subject SHA on the exact GitHub Actions head
native action returns non-empty attestation id URL and bundle path for the engineering probe
domain integrity reference remains a separate SHA-256 reference and is not replaced by the attestation subject
no business candidate state Lot45 branch or Lot46 lock is mutated

target_commands: GitHub Actions certification-provenance workflow transport probe

done_when: canonical provenance semantics remain unchanged and independently validated
native GitHub attestation transport succeeds for an engineering-only exact-head probe
action pin and write permissions are bounded to the exact audited transport
ENG-06.5 can consume attestation evidence without conflating transport success with promotion
